name: Scrap wire
description: Bits of copper. Doc Perrin pays for it.

name: Pirate radio
description: Illegal to own. An audit will find it.

name: Fuse kit
description: Spare fuses for the power grid.

name: Noise-maker
description: A clockwork rattle. Throw it and robots go to see what made the noise.

name: Wire cutters
description: Cuts a camera's cable. The city will send someone to fix it.

name: Stun charge
description: Knocks the nearest robot in reach offline for a while. It is a fight: the alert rises, the robot calls for help, and you lose credits in the scuffle.

name: Slug round
description: Destroys a robot, loudly. The whole city hears, and it is recorded.

name: Laundry locker key
description: A small brass key that came down the chute with you. It has a 9 stamped on it.

name: Queue number
description: A paper ticket with a number on it. Ticket insists it is the right number.

name: Already-served slip
description: Ticket's note that you have been served already. Every window honours it once, and none can say why.

name: Form 12-B
description: Application for Application. Stamped nowhere yet.

name: Appeal receipt (12-B(i))
description: Proof that Form 12-B was appealed before it was stamped.

name: Window 7 stamp
description: A permit stamp, applied under protest, valid and invalid at once.
